summary: Multiple CVEs have been discovered in Temporal Docker images' base dependencies, including critical gRPC authorization bypass (CVE-2026-33186, CVSS 9.1) and high-severity Go crypto/x509 vulnerability (CVE-2025-61729, CVSS 7.5). These require immediate base image updates and Go runtime upgrades.
userImpact: Users running Temporal Docker images may be exposed to critical and high-severity vulnerabilities in base dependencies and runtime libraries.
rootCause: Outdated base image dependencies (OpenSSL, Python, Expat, util-linux) and outdated Go runtime versions in Docker image builds.
proposedFix: Update base Docker images to latest versions, update Go runtime to 1.24.11+ or 1.25.5+, update OpenSSL/Python/Expat/util-linux packages, rebuild Temporal images, and implement automated dependency scanning in CI/CD.
keyQuote: Multiple CVEs have been identified in Temporal Docker images (UI, Admin Tools, Server) affecting base image dependencies
